options.name: address
options.description: IP Address of the B(Server). Must be set to a valid IP address if B(endpoint_type) is set to B(address). Alternatively, it can be left blank.

options.name: auto_create_response_records
options.description: Optional. If the flag is enabled, A, AAAA or CNAME B(Record) is automatically generated. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables/disables B(Server). Defaults to I(false).

options.name: endpoint_type
options.description: The endpoint type configured for the B(Server). Can be IP Address or FQDN. The values of both fields B(address) and B(fqdn) are preserved and are not mutually exclusive, and the B(endpoint_type) defines which one to use. Allowed values: * address * fqdn Defaults to B(address).

options.name: fqdn
options.description: Fully Qualified Domain name of the B(Server). Must be set to a valid FQDN if B(endpoint_type) is set to B(fqdn). Alternatively, it can be left blank.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: records
options.description: Optional. List of B(Records) of the B(Server).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: Optional. The tags for B(Server) in JSON format.
